main_text.p: templor, o Mango, non possum, quin interpellem, ecquid tibi venerit in mentem? quamobrem ad inamœnos illos, & tam tui dissimiles sophistas abieris? Quibus à diurna incubatione, situs: à nocturna lucubratione, tabes: à rimandis minutiis & argutiis, conniventes oculi, distorti & introrsum acti: ab obstructis hypocondriis, squallor, caperata frons, impexum cappillitium, neglecta barba: ab oleo fœda, fœtidaque, à vetustate detrita, ab egestate pannosa lacerna: In eorum Scholis nudi parietes, diffracta vitra, araneisob ducta tabulata, ignotum

page.notes: The left-hand edge shows cropped fragments of text from the facing page (partly legible margin words such as "gyna", "aulæa", "penitus"); these are not transcribed. Catchword: none visible. Possible printing errors left as printed, e.g. "araneisob" and "abieris" are as printed.
